name: WF-245 — Closing Coordination → Critical Dates & Milestone Monitoring

parameters.jsCode: const d=$json.body??$json;const lead_id=d.lead_id??null,deal_id=d.deal_id??null,property_id=d.property_id??null;const coordination_status=String(d.coordination_status??d.status??"").toLowerCase();const closing_date=d.closing_date??null;const milestones=Array.isArray(d.milestones)?d.milestones:[];const blockers=Array.isArray(d.blockers)?d.blockers:[];const now=d.now?new Date(d.now):new Date();const close=new Date(closing_date);let days_to_closing=null;if(closing_date&&!Number.isNaN(close.getTime()))days_to_closing=Math.ceil((close.getTime()-now.getTime())/86400000);const overdue=milestones.filter(m=>m&&m.due_date&&m.status!=="completed"&&new Date(m.due_date)<now);const critical_overdue=overdue.filter(m=>m.critical===true||String(m.priority??"").toLowerCase()==="critical");const completed=milestones.length>0&&milestones.every(m=>m&&m.status==="completed");let status="needs_review",reason="Milestone monitoring requires review.",next="WF-126";if(!lead_id||!deal_id||!property_id){status="blocked";reason="Missing lead, deal, or property identity.";}else if(blockers.length){status="blocked";reason="Unresolved closing blockers are present.";}else if(coordination_status!=="coordination_ready"){status="coordination_not_ready";reason="Closing coordination is not confirmed.";}else if(!closing_date||Number.isNaN(close.getTime())){status="incomplete";reason="A valid closing date is required.";}else if(critical_overdue.length){status="critical_overdue";reason="Critical closing milestones are overdue.";next="WF-246";}else if(overdue.length){status="attention_required";reason="One or more closing milestones are overdue.";next="WF-246";}else if(completed){status="milestones_completed";reason="All tracked closing milestones are complete.";next="WF-247";}else if(days_to_closing!==null&&days_to_closing<=3){status="closing_due_soon";reason="Closing is within three days; milestone monitoring requires heightened attention.";next="WF-246";}else{status="on_track";reason="Closing coordination is ready and tracked milestones are currently on schedule.";next="WF-246";}return[{json:{workflow:"WF-245",lead_id,deal_id,property_id,coordination_status,closing_date,days_to_closing,milestones,overdue_milestones:overdue,critical_overdue_milestones:critical_overdue,milestone_count:milestones.length,completed_milestones:milestones.filter(m=>m&&m.status==="completed").length,monitoring_status:status,reason,requires_human_review:["blocked","critical_overdue","attention_required","closing_due_soon","incomplete","needs_review"].includes(status),next_workflow:next}}];
